project_type: C/C++ MPC cryptographic library (Fireblocks threshold signing)
verification_instructions: Build with cmake and run tests
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - cannot install packages. Use AST analysis only.
contribution_requirements: Security findings must reference SECURITY-MODEL.md sections
key_patterns: OPENSSL_cleanse for secret cleanup, SHA256 for Fiat-Shamir, DRNG for deterministic challenges, BN_CTX for BIGNUM pools
directory_structure: src/common/cosigner/ - CMP protocol implementation; src/common/blockchain/mpc/ - HD derivation; include/ - headers; test/ - Catch2 tests
